predictions.articleTitle: Zamora vs Real Avilés Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Firepower vs Home Urgency
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Real Avilés to avoid defeat via Draw / Away Win alongside Over 2.5 goals, led by a 1:2 away win.
possibilityAssessment: Real Avilés attacking firepower (2.09 goals per match, 14 goals in their last five league games) and four-match away unbeaten run drive a Draw / Away Win call (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 goals backed by a 2.81 combined lambda, 53.3% Poisson Over 2.5 distribution, and Zamora scoring in all six home matches (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Second-half transition expansion after minute 60 if desperate hosts chase the match without Mario Losada (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Avilés's 2.09-goal attack tests Zamora's leaky home defense.

spf.comment: Covers both the primary 1:2 Real Avilés victory and the secondary 1:1 draw, as Avilés's 1.36 concession rate and defensive absences make a single away-win call slightly exposed.

over_under.comment: Combined goal lambda of 2.81, 53.3% Poisson Over 2.5 share, and Real Avilés's 3.45 total goals per league game point above 2.5.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Avilés's 2.00 away scoring rate against Zamora's home concession trend, while 1:1 covers a resilient home stalemate.

goals.comment: Three and two total goals anchor the Poisson distribution peak (22.3% and 23.8%) and mirror the 1:2 and 1:1 scripts.

bqc.comment: A competitive first half at Ruta de la Plata forks after the interval between Real Avilés breaking away (Draw-Loss) and Zamora holding level (Draw-Draw).
